newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lescure wants Canal Plus to control Telepiu.
newsitem.headline: Lescure wants Canal Plus to control Telepiu.

text.p: Pierre Lescure, chairman of French pay TV company Canal Plus, said he wanted a majority of the capital of Italian pay channel Telepiu.
He told an analysts meeting on Canal Plus's 1996 results on Thursday that he would be satisfied with 50.1 percent.
Currently Nethold, whose merger with Canal Plus is to take effect on April 1, holds 45 percent of Telepiu, Germany's Kirchgruppe has 45 percent, and Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest has 10 percent.

"All our partners in Italy want us to take hold of the reins. We want to have access to this small majority. The remainder depends on discussions between Kirch and Bertelsmann. It will come," Lescure said.

Analysts suggest that Canal Plus could sell all or part of its 37.5 percent in German channel Premiere to Bertelsmann, its partner in Premiere which has premption rights on the stake, and to Kirchgruppe, in exchange for Kirchgruppe's holding in Telepiu.
